name_note: GTDB splits the classical genus Anaerotignum, and the _A suffix marks one of those split lineages, so papers using the name Anaerotignum may cover a broader group.

sentences.text: A review of lactate metabolism reports metabolic modelling in which Anaerotignum is among lactate-utilizing strains acting as key symbionts in the gut community.
A seven-day trial in 56 healthy men reported that oral prednisolone decreased Anaerotignum faecicola.
Work on picobirnaviruses identified a bacterium named 'Candidatus Anaerotignum faecalis' as the host of a virus propagated from human faeces.
